Ahtanum.notes: Bright citrus and floral aromas with a soft piney edge.

Amarillo.notes: Flowery orange-citrus — a classic American aroma hop.

Aurora.notes: Slovenian hop with floral, herbal and gently spicy character.

Azacca.notes: Big tropical mango and pineapple with a citrus lift.

Bramling Cross.notes: English hop with dark-berry fruit and lemony spice.

Bravo.notes: Smooth, high-alpha hop with fruity and floral notes.

Goldings.notes: Smooth, sweet, honeyed English aroma hop.

Vanguard.notes: Mild noble-type hop — floral, herbal and woody.

Hersbrucker.notes: Noble German hop — soft floral, herbal and spicy.

Bobek.notes: Slovenian hop — floral and herbal with a light citrus note.

Rakau.notes: New Zealand hop — apricot, stone fruit and clean tropical character.

Pacifica.notes: New Zealand hop — orange citrus, floral and apricot.
